flows.title: Create a course and add its first chapter and lesson
steps: Select + New Course at the top right.
In the Course Builder, make sure you are in the Curriculum tab, then click Add Chapter on the left-hand side.
Name the Chapter title field as you want it, then click Save.
Find the chapter you want the lesson in and click Add Lesson.
Select your Lesson Type, type the lesson name under Lesson Title, add your content and click Save.

flows.title: Publish a course
steps: Click the Draft course you want live.
Click the Publish button, then Publish now.
